question: 创业板指同一天的收盘点位是多少？
answer:
生成查询代码
SELECT 
    b.TRADEDATE AS `交易日期`,
    b.INDX_SNAME AS `指数名称`,
    b.SECCODE AS `指数代码`,
    ROUND(b.TOPEN, 2) AS `开盘价`,
    ROUND(b.TCLOSE, 2) AS `收盘价`,
    ROUND(b.THIGH, 2) AS `最高价`,
    ROUND(b.TLOW, 2) AS `最低价`,
    ROUND(b.LCLOSE, 2) AS `昨收`,
    ROUND(b.CHNG, 2) AS `涨跌`,
    ROUND(b.CHNG_PCT, 2) AS `涨跌幅(%)`,
    ROUND(b.TVALUE/100000000, 2) AS `成交金额(亿)`
FROM 
    GET_INDX_GEN_INFO a
JOIN 
    INDX_MKT b
    ON a.INNER_CODE = b.INNER_CODE
WHERE 
    a.INDX_CODE = '399006'
    AND a.USE_STATUS = '使用'
    AND a.ISVALID = 1
    AND b.SECCODE = '399006'
    AND b.TRADEDATE = '2026-08-31'
    AND b.ISVALID = 1
LIMIT 1;
